Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
AUGAR-EXTRACTOR, JUDET'S PATTERN 



1. Scope— Dimensional and other requirements for Judet's pattern augar extractor, used in 
orthopaedic surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 




ENLARGED VIEW 
THROUGH A 



THREADS, WOOD 
SCREW TYPE, 
PITCH 3 



Ail dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG, 1 AUGAR-EXTRACTOR, JUDET'S PATTERN

Adopted 26 September 1978 



© January 1979, ISI 



INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION 

MANAK BHAVAN, 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG 

NEW OELHl 110002 



IS -.8921-1978 

2.1 A deviation of ±2*5 percent shall be allowed on ail dimensions. 

3. Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30Cr13 or 40Cr13 of IS: 6603-1972 
1 Specification for stainless steel bars and flats '. 

4. Heat Treatment — The augar extractor made from material mentioned in 3 shall be hardened and 
tempered to give a hardness of 550 to 650 HV at the square tip and a hardness of 450 to 550 HV at 
all other portions. 

5. Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 The augar shall have well-formed and cleaned wood screw type threads. The end of the threads 
shall be a diamond point to facilitate easy entry. The handle shall be fitted by screwing and 
welding. 

5.2 The augar shall be free from cracks, draw marks, pits, burrs and other surface defects. 

5.3 The augar shall be polished bright and passivated. 

6. Corrosion Resistance Test — Test the augar extractor in accordance with IS : 7531-1975 
* Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instru- 
ments '. There shall be no sign of corrosion after the test. 

7. Marking — Each augar shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name, initials 
or recognized trade-mark. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



printed at Neelkamai Printers, Delhi, Inc.*
